translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Kalatia
book.title: Kalatia Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Kalatia

content: Dereh datilav naṽit nǝsa dattomabule

Bathudud nadǝlomian, mǝtb̃isab̃ gamit ideh togol nǝsaan ideh, gamit mǝttomatmatu len aNunun aGot, len naṽide tomǝdau, vi tarhǝt san hǝn b̃etǝlmam van hǝn nap̃isal tonor. Be mǝtelǝlǝgau hǝn asike mǝtb̃iteh len nǝsaan totaltal ke mǝtehusuri.
Mǝtesusupah mai gamit gabag len natideh mǝtb̃inau tuhatuh hǝni o mǝtb̃isab̃i len nǝmauran samito ke todaŋ o tomǝlas habat hǝn mǝtb̃evusi. Len naṽide tomaienan, dereh mitigol nǝsa aKristo tokel buni.
Avan ideh b̃inau ke totibau, egǝras gai gabag, sakitin, evi ut kǝmas.
Nǝvanuan tebunus kitev nakitinan husur nauman san sǝb̃on. B̃isab̃i ke b̃ivoi, satenǝnoṽ hǝn gai gabag mai avan ideh am, be elǝboi b̃eṽiv len gai gabag.
Husur nǝvanuan ṽisusua timasgol nauman san sǝb̃on ale satipatpat gai mǝhat husuri.
Alat lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn nap̃usanan hǝn nasoruan siGot, limaskatǝp̃ol hǝn natit p̃isi tovoi lotokade mai ahai p̃usan salito.
Samtegǝras gamit sǝb̃omito. Mǝtsalǝboi mǝtb̃egǝras aGot, ŋit nǝhomit van hǝni. Dereh nǝvanuan tisah tuan naṽit nǝhai sǝlani ŋai, gai tomabule.

Nǝvanuan tomabul nǝsaan niben tolǝŋoni, tohusur nalǝŋonian tosa san gabag, dereh tisah tuan naṽit nǝmatan han. Avil nǝvanuan tomabul nǝsa aNunun aGot tolǝŋoni, dereh tisah tuan naṽit nǝmauran vi sutuai lan.
Sadatipetǝmas hǝn datb̃igol natit tovoi, husur datb̃idaŋ hǝn datb̃ivan am, len nǝboŋ tonor hǝni, dereh datisah tuan naṽit navoian dattogole.
Imaienan, nǝboŋ dattolǝboi datb̃igole, datigol tivoi van hǝn nǝvanuan p̃isi, be a mǝhat hǝn galito, datigol tivoi van hǝn nǝbathudud nadǝlomian.
Nalǝlǝgauan namǝkot mai nasudǝlam̃ian
Mǝteris nab̃iltitosian nototosi gegai nǝboŋ nototos van hǝn gamito len navǝlagw sǝb̃ogw!

Alat lototaltal ke mǝtb̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an, galit luke ligol natit nǝvanuan gail lolǝboi lǝb̃erisi ŋai, luke lisor patpat galit mǝhat husuri, hum tovi nakitinan. Avil lugol natgalenan hǝn asike nǝvanuan gail lǝb̃emǝdas bun galito sil nadǝlomian lotokade len nǝsa aKristo togole len nǝhai balbal.
Husur alat lotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an, galit gabag lǝsahusur nalo, be luke mitikad na-tiv-dalusi-an hǝn lǝb̃isor patpat galit mǝhat hum mǝttavi ahai susur salito, bathut na-tiv-dalusi-an mǝttǝkade.

Be ginau m̃au, saneṽiv hǝn natideh be len nǝmatan siMasta sidato, aYesu Kristo, len nǝhai balbal ŋai. Bathut nǝmatan san maienan, natit p̃isi hǝn navile a pan, lǝsavi natideh len ginau, ale ginau nǝsavi natideh len nabunusian silat navile a pan.
Datb̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an o asike datb̃ikade savi natideh, be nǝmauran veveu aGot togole, enan m̃au, datimaskade!
Alat lotohusur nakelean egai notomadhakele, aGot tigol nǝlolit tikad natǝm̃at, mai nǝlon aGot titaŋis galito. AGot ilekis hǝn galito hǝn lǝb̃evi esan.
Gagai van, avan ideh satigol nǝlogw tetuhatuh am. Husur namelb̃ol notokad gail len nibegw, loṽusan koti ke novi siYesu, novi slev san.
Bathudud nadǝlomian, aMasta sidato, aYesu Kristo teviol kǝmas hǝn navoian mai nanunumito. Ganan.

footnotes.text: 6.16 Len nasoruan ta Kris ike, aIsrael siGot, ale nǝvanuan lotokad namitisau hǝn nasoruan siGot lǝsalǝboii ke aIsrael siGot evi naluṽoh sual am o evi alat lotohusur nakelean aPol tomadhakele.
